title: New Heaven and New Earth
definition: The new heaven and new earth are God's promised renewal of creation where righteousness dwells and God's people live with Him forever.
summary: God will not abandon His creation to corruption. He will make all things new and dwell with His people forever.
christFocus: Christ will make all things new and establish His eternal kingdom.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: God will not abandon His creation to corruption. He will make all things new and dwell with His people forever.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, understand Scripture clearly, and live with hope, obedience, and discernment.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, endurance, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
